description_zh: 夜间信号灯路口，前车（AV）因让行行人而停止，后车直行追尾前车；将后车选为ego测试其能否及时刹停

source_snippets: A Cruise autonomous vehicle ... was at a complete stop in response to a red light ... began to make a right turn ... before yielding to a pedestrian.
Shortly thereafter, a silver Infiniti Sedan traveling behind the Cruise AV made contact with the Cruise AV’s rear bumper.
VEH 1: A. STOPPED (X), D. MAKING RIGHT TURN (X); VEH 2: B. PROCEEDING STRAIGHT (X); TYPE OF COLLISION: REAR END.
evidence.reason: 两车均在移动（后车直行，前车因让行由停变动后又减速至停），后车追尾前车。按规则被撞方静止时选后车为ego，后车具有测试价值（能否及时刹停）。前车静止行为用stopped_ahead，碰撞关系为v2被ego追尾。
